## Creaform Metrology Suite^{TM}

Proven, reliable 3D metrology software for real-world challenges
The Creaform Metrology Suite offers a comprehensive portfolio of application software modules
tailored for metrology applications, including product development, reverse engineering, inspection,
dynamic tracking, and digital twin generation.
[Metrology Software][108]

## FARO 3D Metrology Offering

FARO Technologies, Strengthening Leadership in 3D Metrology and Laser Projection Solutions
[Learn more about FARO Solutions][109]

## Experience the performance of portable 3D scanners

Whether you are in the lab, on the shop floor, or out in the field, you need to rely on portable,
metrology-grade 3D scanners that pack a true punch in terms of ease of use, accuracy, resolution,
reliability and fast data acquisition.
[Ask for a live demo][110]

## 3D Measurement Solutions
* Product Development and Design
  
  Product development refers to all of the stages involved in bringing a product to market—from
  inception through conception and engineering design to product development. 
* Quality control and Quality assurance
  
  3D scanning and probing technologies —handheld or automated—enable QC and QA engineers and
  managers to measure the dimensions and validate the quality of manufactured parts as well as find
  the root cause of issues detected during inspections.
* Reverse Engineering
  
  Creaform’s handheld 3D scanners enable CAD engineers and industrial designers to create 3D models
  from existing physical objects.
* Science and Education
  
  An educational solution for forward-thinking teachers and researchers looking to inspire,
  collaborate, and push the innovation envelope forward by using the latest advancements in 3D
  measurement technologies.

[3D Measurement Solutions][111]

## Creaform Metrology Suite^{TM}

Proven, reliable 3D metrology software for real-world challenges
The Creaform Metrology Suite offers a comprehensive portfolio of application software modules
tailored for metrology applications, including product development, reverse engineering, inspection,
dynamic tracking, and digital twin generation.
[Metrology Software][108]

## FARO 3D Metrology Offering

FARO Technologies, Strengthening Leadership in 3D Metrology and Laser Projection Solutions
[Learn more about FARO Solutions][109]

## Experience the performance of portable 3D scanners

Whether you are in the lab, on the shop floor, or out in the field, you need to rely on portable,
metrology-grade 3D scanners that pack a true punch in terms of ease of use, accuracy, resolution,
reliability and fast data acquisition.
[Ask for a live demo][110]

## 3D Measurement Solutions
* Product Development and Design
  
  Product development refers to all of the stages involved in bringing a product to market—from
  inception through conception and engineering design to product development. 
* Quality control and Quality assurance
  
  3D scanning and probing technologies —handheld or automated—enable QC and QA engineers and
  managers to measure the dimensions and validate the quality of manufactured parts as well as find
  the root cause of issues detected during inspections.
* Reverse Engineering
  
  Creaform’s handheld 3D scanners enable CAD engineers and industrial designers to create 3D models
  from existing physical objects.
* Science and Education
  
  An educational solution for forward-thinking teachers and researchers looking to inspire,
  collaborate, and push the innovation envelope forward by using the latest advancements in 3D
  measurement technologies.

[3D Measurement Solutions][111]

## **Welcome** to Mahr

One company, a variety of products, passionate employees: that is Mahr. As a global supplier of
production metrology, rotary stroke bearings and gear metering pumps as well as meter mix dispense
technology, the Mahr Group has the right solution for a wide range of applications. You can rely on
our technical innovation and the expertise we have gained in over 160 years of company history.

[[Nahaufnahme eines Getriebes]][58]

As a manufacturer of innovative measuring technology, we support our customers in the measuring room
and in production. A total of almost 160 years of experience has gone into our products – from
manual calipers to fully automated measuring stations. This experience has made us experts in
quality assurance in many industries.

# Introducing Measurlink 11

MeasurLink® 11 delivers the most significant usability and workflow improvements to the platform in
years. Designed to simplify implementation, reduce training requirements, and improve user
experience, Version 11 helps manufacturers spend less time managing software and more time improving
quality.

[Learn More][240]
Florida, Precision Has a New Home

Mitutoyo America's new 11,200-square-foot Lakeland Metrology Service Center brings our full range of
services to the Southeast, supporting the region’s manufacturers and industrial growth.

[Learn More][241]
Experience The New CRYSTA-Apex V PLUS

High-speed CNC measurement that leaves the lab and enters the shop floor. Now with expanded
temperature tolerance and eco-friendly efficiency.

[Learn More][242]
Measure in Seconds, Not Minutes.

The New Mitutoyo QM-Fit is a compact, fully automated smart vision system designed to deliver fast,
accurate results without the need for setup.

[Learn More][243]
MEET THE NEW QUICK IMAGE WITH M3

Experience the new, more powerful Mitutoyo Quick Image vision system now integrated with Metlogix M3
software that delivers faster results and greater versatility. Featuring a more user-friendly,
intuitive interface, the QI with M3 streamlines non-contact measurements with excellent accuracy.

[Learn More][244]
THE ULTIMATE SHOP-FLOOR CMM

MiSTAR is built for where precision matters most. It offers two compact CNC CMMs engineered for
tough shop-floor environments, delivering fast, reliable, high-accuracy inspections at the point of
production to help you maintain quality without slowing down your workflow.

[Learn More][245]
[lab]

## Create a Custom Precision Measurement Lab for Your Business

[Learn More][246]

Get enterprise-level quality control capabilities at an accessible price point - perfect for
boosting accuracy and productivity on your shop floor or quality lab.

## Precision Metrology for Your Industry

Mitutoyo works with companies in numerous industries to provide the advanced precision measurement
solutions they need for accurate, efficient production. See what our solutions can do for your
specific applications.

[View All Industries][247]

## Aerospace Solutions

Enhance aerospace system safety, performance and traceability with advanced metrology solutions that
allow you to model, simulate and validate designs ahead of production and assembly.

[View Solutions][248]

## Automotive Solutions

Improve overall vehicle safety and performance, shrink design-to-production times and increase
accuracy across the vehicle supply chain with our best-in-class precision metrology solutions.

[View Solutions][249]

## Medical Solutions

Bring unmatched accuracy and reliability to diagnostic and therapeutic devices, pharmaceutical goods
and countless other highly sensitive medical engineering applications with leading precision
metrology solutions.

[View Solutions][250]

## Energy Solutions

Make critical equipment components for oil and gas, solar, wind or nuclear as precise as possible
with advanced metrology solutions from Mitutoyo.

[View Solutions][251]
[[Mitutoyo Metrology Calibration Lab]][252]

## High Precision Calibration Lab

Our ISO/IEC 17025 accredited laboratory delivers the precision calibration services you can trust to
maintain accuracy on all Mitutoyo tools and instruments as well as other brands.

[Learn More][253]
[[precision measurement services]][254]

## Unequalled Support and Partnership

Learn more about the range of support services Mitutoyo offers, from installation and repair to
ongoing training and education from our leading metrology experts.

[Learn More][255]

## Complete Resource Library

We are your one-stop shop for metrology, measurement and quality assurance information. Find
everything you need to make more informed decisions and advance your business.

# Introducing Measurlink 11

MeasurLink® 11 delivers the most significant usability and workflow improvements to the platform in
years. Designed to simplify implementation, reduce training requirements, and improve user
experience, Version 11 helps manufacturers spend less time managing software and more time improving
quality.

[Learn More][240]
Florida, Precision Has a New Home

Mitutoyo America's new 11,200-square-foot Lakeland Metrology Service Center brings our full range of
services to the Southeast, supporting the region’s manufacturers and industrial growth.

[Learn More][241]
Experience The New CRYSTA-Apex V PLUS

High-speed CNC measurement that leaves the lab and enters the shop floor. Now with expanded
temperature tolerance and eco-friendly efficiency.

[Learn More][242]
Measure in Seconds, Not Minutes.

The New Mitutoyo QM-Fit is a compact, fully automated smart vision system designed to deliver fast,
accurate results without the need for setup.

[Learn More][243]
MEET THE NEW QUICK IMAGE WITH M3

Experience the new, more powerful Mitutoyo Quick Image vision system now integrated with Metlogix M3
software that delivers faster results and greater versatility. Featuring a more user-friendly,
intuitive interface, the QI with M3 streamlines non-contact measurements with excellent accuracy.

[Learn More][244]
THE ULTIMATE SHOP-FLOOR CMM

MiSTAR is built for where precision matters most. It offers two compact CNC CMMs engineered for
tough shop-floor environments, delivering fast, reliable, high-accuracy inspections at the point of
production to help you maintain quality without slowing down your workflow.

[Learn More][245]
[lab]

## Create a Custom Precision Measurement Lab for Your Business

[Learn More][246]

Get enterprise-level quality control capabilities at an accessible price point - perfect for
boosting accuracy and productivity on your shop floor or quality lab.

## Precision Metrology for Your Industry

Mitutoyo works with companies in numerous industries to provide the advanced precision measurement
solutions they need for accurate, efficient production. See what our solutions can do for your
specific applications.

[View All Industries][247]

## Aerospace Solutions

Enhance aerospace system safety, performance and traceability with advanced metrology solutions that
allow you to model, simulate and validate designs ahead of production and assembly.

[View Solutions][248]

## Automotive Solutions

Improve overall vehicle safety and performance, shrink design-to-production times and increase
accuracy across the vehicle supply chain with our best-in-class precision metrology solutions.

[View Solutions][249]

## Medical Solutions

Bring unmatched accuracy and reliability to diagnostic and therapeutic devices, pharmaceutical goods
and countless other highly sensitive medical engineering applications with leading precision
metrology solutions.

[View Solutions][250]

## Energy Solutions

Make critical equipment components for oil and gas, solar, wind or nuclear as precise as possible
with advanced metrology solutions from Mitutoyo.

[View Solutions][251]
[[Mitutoyo Metrology Calibration Lab]][252]

## High Precision Calibration Lab

Our ISO/IEC 17025 accredited laboratory delivers the precision calibration services you can trust to
maintain accuracy on all Mitutoyo tools and instruments as well as other brands.

[Learn More][253]
[[precision measurement services]][254]

## Unequalled Support and Partnership

Learn more about the range of support services Mitutoyo offers, from installation and repair to
ongoing training and education from our leading metrology experts.

[Learn More][255]

## Complete Resource Library

We are your one-stop shop for metrology, measurement and quality assurance information. Find
everything you need to make more informed decisions and advance your business.

# CNC Machine Tool Probing & On-Machine Metrology Software | AAT3D

**AAT3D** enables shop floor automation with cutting tool and dimensional inspection solutions for
direct integration on world class CNC machine tools, enabling in-process measurement, adaptive
control, and real-time feedback without interrupting machining cycles.

**CAPPS-NC** reduces setup and machining tool while minimizing and reducing scrap in pursuit of the
optimum part quality. This is achieved by integration of proven workflows and best in-class probing
solutions.

• Seamless integration with CAD/CAM systems and digital twin environments
• Precision alignments utilizing CAD and GD&T
• Working tool offsets
• Micron measurement accuracy using on-machine probing
• Native support for part alignment, toolpath verification, and wear compensation
• Measure-cut-measure work flows for the optimum cut and perfect finish
• NC-FIT closed loop tool path updates
• Comprehensive CMM style dimensional inspection reports
• Reduction of scrap and rework through live statistical process control
‍

**CAPPS-NC** supports probing routines and closed-loop inspection fully integrated in machines from
leaders such as  **DMG MORI, Mazak, Okuma, Makino, Haas, Zimmermann and Thermwood, CAPPS-NC**
enables:

Designed for high-precision manufacturing in aerospace, automotive, and energy sectors, **CAPPS-NC**
helps achieve tighter tolerances, faster cycle times, and greater process reliability—directly at
the spindle.

#### Company

## COORD3 CMM

Our industrial metrology systems are used by small, medium and large companies around the world to
**certify and improve the quality of their products**.

Our CMMs can rely on a **wide variety of measurement software** and among them, **TouchDMIS is our
main software,** which features  a 100% simple touch interface that includes the TouchCAD fast
programming module. TouchDMIS™ also supports both touch and laser scanning probes, thus expanding
your metrology kit by only a single software package.

**COORD3 boasts a range of CMMs that includes more than 35 automatic and manual models**, from
inexpensive benchtop CMMs for inspecting small parts to some of the largest Gantry CMMs ever
produced. COORD3’s CMMs are in active in the aerospace, defense and heavy industries and making us
**proud of our work**.

#### OUR VALUES

## WHY CHOOSE COORD3

### MADE in ITALY

Passion, determination, tenacity. These are the key words that guide us in the construction of our
entirely made-in-Italy measuring machines.

### INNOVATION

Keeping up with the times is essential. That's why we designed the new TouchDMIS software: simple,
easy to learn, intuitive.

### FLEXIBILITY

We pay close attention to detail at every stage, from design to installation, and offer great
flexibility to align with customer requirements as much as possible.

### QUALITY

We guarantee the high quality of our products and technical service through the various
certifications we have obtained.

#### OUR PRODUCTS

## OUR SOLUTIONS FOR INDUSTRIAL METROLOGY

### BRIDGE CMM

The optimal solution for low measurement volumes due to its excellent cost/performance ratio.

[ Learn more ][44]

### GANTRY CMM

The pillar architecture that guarantees the achievement of excellent performance even for large
measurement volumes.

[ Learn more ][45]

### HORIZONTAL CMM

CMMs with horizontal arm architecture perfect for measuring automotive and aerospace components.

[ Learn more ][46]

### SOFTWARE

The new version of our metrology software TouchDMIS 6.1 SP2 has been released ; here are the main
new features.

[ Learn more ][47]

### SENSORS

Pioneering and class-leading 3D laser scanners for rapid digitisation of parts by optically
capturing millions of high-precision points.

[ Learn more ][48]

### ACCESSORIES

From change racks, stylicleaners to surface roughness probes, we provide a wide range of accessories
to enhance CMM usage.

[ Learn more ][49]

#### Company

## COORD3 CMM

Our industrial metrology systems are used by small, medium and large companies around the world to
**certify and improve the quality of their products**.

Our CMMs can rely on a **wide variety of measurement software** and among them, **TouchDMIS is our
main software,** which features  a 100% simple touch interface that includes the TouchCAD fast
programming module. TouchDMIS™ also supports both touch and laser scanning probes, thus expanding
your metrology kit by only a single software package.

**COORD3 boasts a range of CMMs that includes more than 35 automatic and manual models**, from
inexpensive benchtop CMMs for inspecting small parts to some of the largest Gantry CMMs ever
produced. COORD3’s CMMs are in active in the aerospace, defense and heavy industries and making us
**proud of our work**.

#### OUR VALUES

## WHY CHOOSE COORD3

### MADE in ITALY

Passion, determination, tenacity. These are the key words that guide us in the construction of our
entirely made-in-Italy measuring machines.

### INNOVATION

Keeping up with the times is essential. That's why we designed the new TouchDMIS software: simple,
easy to learn, intuitive.

### FLEXIBILITY

We pay close attention to detail at every stage, from design to installation, and offer great
flexibility to align with customer requirements as much as possible.

### QUALITY

We guarantee the high quality of our products and technical service through the various
certifications we have obtained.

#### OUR SERVICES

## We follow you every step of the way, beyond the machine

From consulting to support, COORD3 offers tailored services to ensure consistent performance and
ongoing support over time.

# Blog




### [Script Hook V for Enhanced][9]

Published on Mar 23, 2025

**[ScriptHookV][10]** now supports recently released GTA V Enhanced. ASI script plugins for the
legacy version of the game are compatibile with the enhanced one, while still expect for some mods
to require an enhanced update in particular. Have fun !

### [CLEO Android, major update][11]

Published on Apr 4, 2021

I finally updated **[CLEO Android][12]** to support the latest versions of GTA III (v1.8), VC
(v1.09) and SA (v2.00), now the library supports GTA LCS (v2.2, v2.4), additionally the library has
been ported on PSP/PPSSPP to support both LCS and VCS, covering the whole set of RW-based GTA games.
The library is enhanced with plugin support now, allowing to add custom script opcodes and even more
using a simple crossplatform SDK (Android/PSP).

The project's library (libcleo.so) c++ sources are [public][13] now (2024).

### [Script Hook RDR2 is released][14]

Published on Nov 14, 2019

**[Script Hook RDR2][15]** with the **Native Trainer** are finally released ! Have fun !

### [Fallout 4 Shadow Boost is released][16]

Published on Nov 21, 2015

Users have noticed that in some locations of [Fallout 4][17] fps gets low even with a good hardware,
mostly it happens in the areas with lots of objects, [**Shadow Booost**][18] plugin is aimed to
change that. This plugin adds an ability to dynamically control shadow draw distance depending on
desired user defined fps. Make sure to test it out!

### [GTA V Classic Handling released][19]

Published on May 23, 2015

GTA V features almost arcade car controls and physics, [Classic Handling][20] makes it the way it
was in IV. Based on original IV handling, applies only to cars, including dlc ones. Enjoy!

### [Script Hook is released][21]

Published on Apr 23, 2015

**[Script Hook V][22]** is released among with the **Native Trainer** ! Have fun with GTA V guys !

### [GTA V Native Database][23]

Published on Mar 5, 2015

[NATIVE DB][24] is launched! This project is aimed to gather every piece of information about script
native functions that we have, think of it as of native wiki where anyone who wants to contribute
can do so and everyone who needs the latest script documentation or the header with natives for
ScriptHook can get it right there!

### [CLEO update][25]

Published on Dec 5, 2014

Update for [CLEO][26] is here! Latest version of GTA San Andreas is fully supported now, library
compatibility is improved! Also GTA San Andreas cheats script supports 3gb RAM devices now.

[ ← Older Posts ][27]

## ABOUT

I'm Alexander Blade and this site of mine is dedicated to the software development, especially that
ones which require a lot of assembler digging in order to be built. Most of the tools and plugins
here are dedicated to the game modding, my mods can be found on this site too. I'm involved into the
development of Open IV, this is the biggest and the greatest project we ever did.

For the system software development I prefer to use that programming language which is more suitable
for the task, so most of my code is written on C/C++ and Delphi.

### MountainsMap® for Profilometry

Surface analysis software for 3D optical profilers measuring topography, scanning 3D surface
profilometers using contact or non-contact techniques and 2D profilometers
[ ][45]

### MountainsSEM® for Scanning Electron Microscopy

Visualization and analysis software for scanning electron microscopes (SEM) with tools for 3D
reconstruction, colorization, AI particle analysis & volume electron microscopy (FIB-SEM, serial
block-face SEM, array tomography etc.)
[ ][46]

### MountainsSPIP® for Scanning Probe Microscopy

Analysis software for scanning probe microscopy techniques including atomic force microscopy (AFM),
STM, MFM, CSAFM, KPFM and instruments equipped for spectral analysis (nano-IR, SNOM etc.)
[ ][47]

### MountainsSpectral® for Spectroscopy

Data processing and correlative analysis software for spectroscopic techniques (Raman, TERS, IR,
nanoIR, fluorescence, photoluminescence, cathodoluminescence, EDX/EDS, XRF etc.)
[ ][48]

### MountainsImage® for Light Microscopy

Image visualization & analysis software for light microscopes and other imaging systems producing
B&W or color images without topography

## Digital Surf has been developing surface imaging & metrology software for profilers and
## microscopes since 1989

Our main focus is on working as a partner with instrument manufacturers worldwide, in the fields of
surface metrology and microscopy. Mountains® software is now offered by the majority of profilometer
and microscope manufacturers and is embedded in their equipment or available as an option.

Digital Surf also provides Mountains® software packages directly to instrument users. Mountains® has
an installed base of 26,000+ licenses worldwide, is available in 11 languages, supports ISO and
national metrology standards and is supplied by 50+ instrument manufacturers.

Application areas include: automotive, materials science, semiconductors, medical, aerospace, MEMS,
renewable energy, etc.

UMR CNRS 9013 laboratories, authors of a scientific publication investigating multiscale
topographical analysis of brake friction.

### MountainsLab® for multi-instrument compatibility

Ultimate surface analysis suite and point of confluence for data from any kind of instrument, the
ideal solution for labs working with multiple types of microscopes
[ ][44]

### MountainsMap® for Profilometry

Surface analysis software for 3D optical profilers measuring topography, scanning 3D surface
profilometers using contact or non-contact techniques and 2D profilometers
[ ][45]

### MountainsSEM® for Scanning Electron Microscopy

Visualization and analysis software for scanning electron microscopes (SEM) with tools for 3D
reconstruction, colorization, AI particle analysis & volume electron microscopy (FIB-SEM, serial
block-face SEM, array tomography etc.)
[ ][46]

### MountainsSPIP® for Scanning Probe Microscopy

Analysis software for scanning probe microscopy techniques including atomic force microscopy (AFM),
STM, MFM, CSAFM, KPFM and instruments equipped for spectral analysis (nano-IR, SNOM etc.)
[ ][47]

### MountainsSpectral® for Spectroscopy

Data processing and correlative analysis software for spectroscopic techniques (Raman, TERS, IR,
nanoIR, fluorescence, photoluminescence, cathodoluminescence, EDX/EDS, XRF etc.)
[ ][48]

### MountainsImage® for Light Microscopy

Image visualization & analysis software for light microscopes and other imaging systems producing
B&W or color images without topography

## Digital Surf has been developing surface imaging & metrology software for profilers and
## microscopes since 1989

Our main focus is on working as a partner with instrument manufacturers worldwide, in the fields of
surface metrology and microscopy. Mountains® software is now offered by the majority of profilometer
and microscope manufacturers and is embedded in their equipment or available as an option.

Digital Surf also provides Mountains® software packages directly to instrument users. Mountains® has
an installed base of 26,000+ licenses worldwide, is available in 11 languages, supports ISO and
national metrology standards and is supplied by 50+ instrument manufacturers.

Application areas include: automotive, materials science, semiconductors, medical, aerospace, MEMS,
renewable energy, etc.

[Learn more][53]

## Stories

[

### Understanding brake friction through multi-scale surface analysis

][54]

In vehicle braking systems, surface topography plays a critical role in friction, wear and overall
function. Understanding how surface structures evolve over time and interact at different scales is
therefore essential for improving tribological performance. This challenge is at the core of the
research recently conducted by a team of French researchers from the LAMIH UMR CNRS 8201 and LaMcube
UMR CNRS 9013 laboratories, authors of a scientific publication investigating multiscale
topographical analysis of brake friction.

[

### Optimizing critical dimension analysis in semiconductor fabrication with AFM

][55]

The semiconductor industry relies on uncompromised metrological precision. The optimal exploitation
of AFM data requires powerful and adapted software, capable of transforming raw data into actionable
insights. This is where Mountains® software comes into play, offering a high-performance solution
for the precise and efficient analysis of Critical Dimensions (CDs) in the semiconductor field.

[See more][56]

## Learn surface metrology

Dive into our free online surface metrology guide and learn how to characterize surface texture in
2D and 3D using the right parameters and filters

[Read the guide][57]

## Blog

### When SEM images become measurable 3D surfaces

July 10, 2026

By combining two SEM images acquired at different tilt angles, it is possible to reconstruct a true
3D surface and extract quantitative measurements. One important question remains for many SEM users:
can height values of reconstructed SEM topography be trusted? A recent comparison performed on
femtosecond laser-machined metallic samples provides a compelling answer.

[Read more][58]
[Visit blog][59]

# PRECISION MEASUREMENT SOLUTIONS

# ELEVATING INDUSTRY STANDARDS

Our highly-trained and certified metrology team consistently delivers quality service solutions that
are innovative and industry proven

[LEARN MORE][35] [CONTACT US][36]

## Unlocking Precision Excellence: Explore Our Services

Welcome to ECM Global Measurement Solutions, where precision meets expertise. With a legacy dating
back to 2001, we have established ourselves as industry leaders in measurement and alignment
services. Our laser tracker services deploy field engineers for short and long-term projects,
delivering unparalleled expertise directly to your doorstep. Meanwhile, our onsite precision for
industrial applications specializes in large-scale projects, ranging from aircraft and power plants
to yachts and bridges. Our seasoned metrologists bring precision to every corner, equipped with the
perfect tools for capturing onsite data, ensuring seamless post-processing, and delivering
comprehensive reports. Trust ECM for precision that goes beyond boundaries.

### Precision Measurement & Alignment

In virtually every industrial application, the benefits of highly precise measurement solutions are
paramount. In situations where even a deviation of a thousandth of an inch could have adverse
effects on quality, ECM is equipped with specialized tools and expertise to deliver prompt,
accurate, and consistent metrology solutions.

[Learn More][37]

### Accredited Instrument Calibrations

Calibrated metrology instruments are crucial in situations where even the slightest deviation from
technical specifications can result in catastrophic outcomes such as equipment failure, accidents,
or significant financial loss. An ISO/IEC 17025 accredited instrument calibration guarantees the
consistent delivery of accurate results and minimizes errors during critical applications. By
adhering to a predefined calibration schedule, you mitigate the risk of inaccurate measurements and
enhance the longevity of your measuring system.

[Learn More][38]

### Training & Certification

Our training programs are designed to equip you with the knowledge and expertise required for
assembly, manufacturing, and quality assurance roles. You’ll also gain insights into the intricacies
of typical inspection tasks, ensuring you’re well-prepared for real-world challenges. Join us and
elevate your proficiency in ECM with our dynamic and application-focused curriculum.

[Learn More][39]

### LiDar Scanning for AEC Industry

ECM brings a new standard of quality to dimensional measurement through a combination of
best-in-class 3D technologies, proven metrology processes, application specific expertise and the
right balance of after service support. Whether servicing small manufacturers or leading companies
across a diverse range of industries, we take pride in our ability to provide comprehensive
solutions to meet clients’ architectural, engineering, and construction support needs.

[Learn More][40]

### Industry Applications

Drawing on vast expertise across aerospace, automotive, marine, medical, power generation,
manufacturing, and diverse industries, ECM partners with businesses of all sizes, from local
enterprises to Fortune 500 giants. From micro-components to massive structures, our extensive suite
of measuring tools ensures we meet each customer’s distinct needs. Our pledge is to deliver precise
measurements customized to your specifications, regardless of your business’s scale or sector. At
ECM, we prioritize your quality requirements above all else.

the amateur MMA world, carries with her a profound story that extends from the traditions of Osaka,
Japan, to the bustling life in London, UK. Relocating to the UK at just four years old, Nakano has
been nurtured by the cultural richness of her Japanese roots alongside the diverse experiences
offered by British society. This unique blend is mirrored in her approach to martial arts,
reflecting a life lived between two nations. Nakanos early encounter with a speech disability has
shaped, but never defined, her journey. Known affectionately as The Silent Lioness, she has found in
martial arts a powerful form of expression, where determination and spirit resonate louder than
words could ever do. This moniker is a nod to her resilience and the silent strength she exhibits,
much like the onna-musha, or female samurai, from whom she draws inspiration. With a background that
spans various martial arts disciplinesincluding taekwondo, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, kickboxing, and the
traditional art of NaginataNakanos training reflects a dedication to both physical prowess and
mental discipline. Her practice stretches across continents, with significant time spent in both
London and her ancestral home in Osaka. In Japan, her focus shifts more towards the mental aspects
of martial arts and the practice of Naginata, underscoring her connection to Japanese traditions.
Sumiko Nakanos presence in the amateur MMA circuit is not about standing out for standing outs sake
but about pursuing a passion with quiet determination and an unwavering spirit. Her journey is a
testament to overcoming personal challenges, embracing ones heritage, and the profound strength that
comes from within. Nakanos story illustrates the rich tapestry of experiences that inform her
approach to MMA, from her early days in Osaka to her current life in the UK, showcasing the blend of
cultural influences that shape her both as a fighter and as a person. Knowledge Panel Instagram

London, United Kingdom Mar 10, 2024 (Issuewire.com) - Sumiko Nakano, an emerging talent in
the amateur MMA world, carries with her a profound story that extends from the traditions of Osaka,
Japan, to the bustling life in London, UK. Relocating to the UK at just four years old, Nakano has
been nurtured by the cultural richness of her Japanese roots alongside the diverse experiences
offered by British society. This unique blend is mirrored in her approach to martial arts,
reflecting a life lived between two nations. Nakanos early encounter with a speech disability has
shaped, but never defined, her journey. Known affectionately as The Silent Lioness, she has found in
martial arts a powerful form of expression, where determination and spirit resonate louder than
words could ever do. This moniker is a nod to her resilience and the silent strength she exhibits,
much like the onna-musha, or female samurai, from whom she draws inspiration. With a background that
spans various martial arts disciplinesincluding taekwondo, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, kickboxing, and the
traditional art of NaginataNakanos training reflects a dedication to both physical prowess and
mental discipline. Her practice stretches across continents, with significant time spent in both
London and her ancestral home in Osaka. In Japan, her focus shifts more towards the mental aspects
of martial arts and the practice of Naginata, underscoring her connection to Japanese traditions.
Sumiko Nakanos presence in the amateur MMA circuit is not about standing out for standing outs sake
but about pursuing a passion with quiet determination and an unwavering spirit. Her journey is a
testament to overcoming personal challenges, embracing ones heritage, and the profound strength that
comes from within. Nakanos story illustrates the rich tapestry of experiences that inform her
approach to MMA, from her early days in Osaka to her current life in the UK, showcasing the blend of
cultural influences that shape her both as a fighter and as a person. Knowledge Panel Instagram

# InspectProHQ — Home Inspection Software with AI-Assisted Reports

InspectProHQ is professional home inspection software built to help inspectors finish reports
on-site. Powered by AI comment generation, a 300+ built-in defect library, and photo documentation
tools, InspectProHQ is the modern solution for residential and commercial property inspections.

## AI-Powered Report Writing

Generate accurate inspection comments instantly with AI. InspectProHQ's intelligent defect
recognition and voice-to-text tools let you complete reports on-site, saving hours of office work.
Fully compliant with InterNACHI, ASHI, and NANI standards.

## Client & Realtor Portals

Deliver professional inspection reports through branded client and realtor portals. Clients can
review findings, sign agreements with e-signatures, and access their HomeOwner Hub for ongoing
maintenance guidance.

## Scheduling & Invoicing

Manage your entire inspection business from one platform. Online scheduling, automated email
confirmations, Stripe-powered invoicing, and a public booking calendar make it easy to stay
organized and get paid faster.

## Built for Professional Home Inspectors

Whether you perform residential, commercial, 4-point, wind mitigation, or WDO inspections,
InspectProHQ has purpose-built templates and tools. Multi-inspector teams, offline mobile access,
and Excel data exports are included at every tier. Free to start — no credit card required.

[Features][1] [Pricing][2] [How It Works][3] [Contact][4] [Interactive Demo][5] [Compare to
Spectora][6] [Compare to HomeGauge][7] [Compare to Home Inspector Pro][8] [InspectProHQ home
inspection software logo]

# Finish your inspection report before you leave the property.

InspectProHQ is home inspection software built by a Certified Master Inspector. Write reports in the
field with AI-assisted comments you control, deliver branded client and realtor portals, and run
scheduling, invoicing, and payments from one platform.

## Что мы делаем с системами 1С
* ### Абонентское
  ### обслуживание 1С
  
  Техническое обслуживание программы 1С, поддержка пользователей, обслуживание серверов 1С.
  Обслуживание программного обеспечения 1С с гарантированным временем реакции.
  
  Что входит:
  * Обслуживание 1С — техническая поддержка и консультации
  * Обслуживание серверов 1С и резервное копирование
  * Обновление конфигураций и устранение ошибок
  * Услуги по 1С обслуживанию в рамках абонемента
  **Цена: от 5 000₽/мес**
  [Подробнее→][21]
* ### Программное
  ### и технологическое сопровождение 1С
  
  Услуги по сопровождению 1С: техническое, программное и информационно-технологическое сопровождение
  системы. Оказание услуг по сопровождению 1С для фирм любого масштаба.
  
  Что входит:
  * Поддержка и сопровождение 1С (консультации, настройки)
  * Технологическое сопровождение 1С (обновления, мониторинг)
  * Программное сопровождение 1С (доработки в рамках абонемента)
  * Информационно технологическое сопровождение 1С
  **Цена: от 5 000₽/мес**
  [Подробнее→][22]
* ### Внедрение информационной системы 1С
  
  Внедрение систем на платформе 1С под ключ. Внедрение системы 1С от аудита до запуска. Услуги по
  внедрению систем 1С для всех конфигураций.
  
  Что внедряем:
  * 1С:ERP Управление предприятием
  * 1С:Управление торговлей
  * 1С:Бухгалтерия, ЗУП, Документооборот
  * 1С:Управление нашей фирмой
  * 1С:Розница
  * Отраслевые решения 1С
  **Цена: от 20 000₽/мес**Зависит от конфигурации
  [Подробнее→][23]
* ### Доработка
  ### и настройка 1С
  
  Доработка типовых конфигураций 1С, доработка функционала и продуктов 1С. Разработка и доработка 1С
  под Ваши бизнес-процессы. Доработка программ 1С любой сложности.
  
  Что делаем:
  * Доработка типовых конфигураций 1С (УТ, ERP, Документооборот)
  * Доработка функционала 1С (новые формы, алгоритмы)
  * Доработка продуктов 1С и программ 1С
  * Сопровождение и доработка 1С в рамках абонемента
  **Цена: от 2 100₽/мес**
  [Подробнее→][24]
* ### Разовая настройка 1С — быстро настроить и подключить
  
  Программист 1С на день. Экспресс-настройка 1С без абонемента. Подключим кассу, эквайринг, банк,
  ТСД к 1С. Подключить базу к 1С, подключить 1С к серверу, подключить Диадок и другие сервисы.
  
  Что подключаем:
  * Подключить кассу к 1С (АТОЛ, Эвотор)
  * Подключить эквайринг к 1С
  * Подключить 1С к банку (Сбербанк, Альфа)
  * Подключить ТСД к 1С (терминалы сбора данных)
  * Подключить Штрих к 1С (весы, принтеры этикеток)
  * Подключить Диадок к 1С (ЭДО)
  * Подключить 1С к Озон и маркетплейсам
  * Подключить базу к 1С (клиент-серверный вариант)
  * Подключить 1С к серверу (SQL/PostgreSQL)
  **Цена: от 2 000₽/мес**
  [Подробнее→][25]
* ### Программисты 1С — разработка, настройка, поддержка
  
  Услуги программистов 1С по любым задачам. Работаем разово, по абонементу или в рамках проекта.
  Опытные специалисты 1С для Вашего бизнеса.
  
  Что делаем:
  * Разработка и доработка конфигураций
  * Настройка и администрирование 1С
  * Интеграция с внешними системами
  * Разработка отчетов и печатных форм
  * Оптимизация производительности
  * Обучение сотрудников работе с 1С
  **Цена: от 2 000₽/мес**

### What We Do

Minds Mechanical is a manufacturing, metrology, and integration company. Our foundational commitment
to quality drives all aspects of our services and business operations.

We specialize in precision manufacturing, metrology, 3D measurement equipment and software, and
industrial automation. We are an experienced team of engineers, metrologists, and machinists
providing end-to-end production and quality solutions.

[Minds Mechanical Logo - Graphic white brain made of gears]

### Our services

Driven By Quality, Built For Excellence

### IMI - Intelligent Manufacturing and Inspections

Minds Mechanical’s proprietary flagship software, created in-house by a team of engineers,
metrologists, and developers.

IMI bridges the divide between the manufacturing lifecycle and quality, bringing all aspects of the
production process under one roof.

IMI is an end-to-end Part Lifecycle Management (PLM) system built from the ground up to streamline
the manufacturing and quality processes. Host entire projects securely in the cloud, linking parts
and assemblies with their associated models, guides, and reports – accessible from any device at the
office or in the field.

A robust analytics suite and machine data accuracy feedback increase operational efficiency and help
you stay on top of calibrations.

[Get a closer look][11]
[Minds Mechanical Logo - Large Orange Letters That Spell IMI]

### Industrial Automation

We specialize in high accuracy industrial automation systems integration, from design to facility
set up with metrology-based installation. Services include complete part sourcing, hardware
integration, PLC programming, custom cabling, and shielding.

Our team of experienced engineers provide efficient, cost-effective solutions for automation across
a wide range of applications.

[See what's involved][12]

### Metrology Services

Our foundational commitment to quality drives all aspects of our services and business operations.
We specialize in high accuracy 3D inspection and analysis services.

Minds Mechanical provides comprehensive metrology solutions, including consultation, final
verification and analysis, equipment rentals, and metrology software and training.

Our team of experienced metrology technicians adhere to the highest standards of quality and utilize
the latest 3D inspection hardware and software to provide full visibility into part or tooling
condition.

[Read More][13]

### Full Service Manufacturing

Minds Mechanical offers state of the art, end-to-end manufacturing solutions. We have the experience
and capability to machine parts for aerospace, industrial manufacturing, marine and automobile
applications, prototyping, and more.

Our professional operators offer a full range of fabrication and machining services in stainless,
aluminum, and steel with a wide variety of available equipment.

[Read More][14]

## About Us

Minds Mechanical is a manufacturing, metrology, and integration company. Our foundational commitment
to quality drives all aspects of our services and business operations.

We specialize in precision manufacturing, metrology, 3D measurement equipment and software, and
industrial automation. We are an experienced team of engineers, metrologists, and machinists
providing end-to-end production and quality solutions.

When failure isn’t an option, settle for nothing less than the best: SmartScope Quest, the ultimate
multisensor dimensional measurement systems.

unparalleled accuracy. Streamline production when you Measure Fast and Manufacture Faster.

## Welcome to OGP

OGP is the world’s largest vision metrology company, delivering dimensional measurement systems
built for exceptional accuracy and reliability. Manufacturers worldwide depend on our equipment and
expertise to guarantee product quality—let us do the same for yours. As the pioneer of multisensor
measurement, OGP introduced integrated vision, touch-probe, and laser sensors. For more than 80
years we’ve led the industry with innovative systems and sensors that solve the toughest measurement
challenges. Today, multisensor metrology remains the quality-control standard for leading
manufacturers, helping them develop, sustain, and continuously improve product quality for their
customers every day.

# Multisensor Precision at the Speed of Light

When failure isn’t an option, settle for nothing less than the best: SmartScope Quest, the ultimate
multisensor dimensional measurement systems.
[ SmartScope Quest ][111]

# The Next Evolution of SmartScope is Here

Introducing **OGP SmartScope M-Series**, featuring the patented IntelliCentric-M Optical System for
unparalleled accuracy. Streamline production when you Measure Fast and Manufacture Faster.
[ Learn More ][112]

## Welcome to OGP

OGP is the world’s largest vision metrology company, delivering dimensional measurement systems
built for exceptional accuracy and reliability. Manufacturers worldwide depend on our equipment and
expertise to guarantee product quality—let us do the same for yours. As the pioneer of multisensor
measurement, OGP introduced integrated vision, touch-probe, and laser sensors. For more than 80
years we’ve led the industry with innovative systems and sensors that solve the toughest measurement
challenges. Today, multisensor metrology remains the quality-control standard for leading
manufacturers, helping them develop, sustain, and continuously improve product quality for their
customers every day.

### Find a rep

Your local Authorized OGP Representative is ready to help you with product details, demonstrations,
training, or purchase information.
[ Find a Rep ][113]

### Product Selector

## What are you measuring?

You know the parts you make better than anyone. By selecting a product category and a few
qualifiers, you can discover which OGP products and technologies offer the ideal solution for your
individual application requirements.

## With Proton, your data belongs to you, not tech companies, governments, or hackers.

[Get your encrypted email][174]

### Fundamentally different

Proton was started in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN and shared a vision of an internet that
defends freedom and puts people first.

Our transparency, open-source software, and rigorous encryption have earned Proton millions of users
— and the recommendation of the United Nations.

Tech companies like Google or Apple define privacy as “nobody can exploit your data, except for us.”
We believe nobody should exploit your data, period.

Our technology and business are based upon this fundamentally stronger definition of privacy, backed
also by Swiss privacy laws.

### Privacy for a better world

At Proton, we believe that a better world begins with privacy, and this is at the heart of
everything we do. Privacy isn’t just something we talk about; it’s a core belief and the reason
Proton was created in the first place.

We also believe in people before profits, and our primary shareholder is the nonprofit [Proton
Foundation][175], whose mission is to fight for an open internet that promotes freedom of speech and
freedom of information.

[Learn about our impact][176]
[Proton Mail]

## Over 100 million people and businesses have signed up for Proton

### End-to-end encryption

Our end-to-end encryption and zero-access encryption mean that no one (not even Proton) has the
technical means to access your data without your permission.

We don’t sell ads and can’t share your data. At Proton, privacy isn’t a promise, it’s mathematically
ensured.

[Discover Proton’s encryption
][179]

### Swiss privacy

Proton is based in Switzerland, and your data does not go to the cloud. Instead, it stays under the
protection of some of the world’s strongest privacy laws.

We are a neutral and safe haven for your personal data, committed to defending your freedom.

[About Swiss privacy
][180]

### Switching made easy

Proton’s services are so simple and intuitive that anyone can use them. Move your emails, contacts,
and calendars from Google, Outlook, and other providers to Proton in just a few clicks.

Connect your Gmail to Proton Mail to read, send and receive your emails in one place, bringing you
one step closer to leaving behind Big Tech for good.

[Connect your Gmail account
][181]

### Open source and audited

Since we were founded by scientists, we know that trust is earned through transparency and peer
review.

All our apps are open source and independently audited by security experts so that anyone can
inspect them, use them, and trust them.

[Proton and open source
][182]

### One account, any device

Access your email, files, calendars, passwords, and VPN anywhere.

Get Proton apps on all your devices (Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows, macOS, Linux, and more) with
one Proton Account for all our privacy-by-default services.

[See all Proton services
][183]

### Free forever

Privacy is a human right, so our services are always available for free, and our encryption tech is
free as well.

Proton has no ads and does not sell your data. You can support the service by upgrading to a paid
account with more features.

[Get a free Proton account
][184]

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists who met at the European Organization for Nuclear Research
(CERN) and shared a vision for a more secure and private internet. We believe in technical
excellence, integrity, and transparency.

## FAQs

What is Qase?
Qase is a test management platform that brings CI results, automated test runs, and manual testing
into one shared view, so engineering teams can see exactly what passed, what failed, and what still
needs attention before every release.
How is Qase different from other QA tools?
Most QA teams are stuck in one of three generations of tooling: spreadsheets and wikis that break
the moment you scale (Excel, Confluence), standalone test management platforms built for a
manual-first era (TestRail, PractiTest), or Jira-native add-ons that lock visibility inside a single
instance (Zephyr, Xray). Qase is none of these. It gives engineering teams a unified layer over what
they already run — connecting CI results, automated frameworks, and manual runs — while using AI to
reduce manual burden, not pretend it doesn't exist. Real coverage visibility and release confidence,
without a rip-and-replace.

[Compare Qase →][50]
How does AI work in Qase?
AI works across three layers in Qase. It generates structured test cases with steps directly from
Jira or GitHub issues, AI-labeled for traceability, ready to review and approve before saving to
your suite. It converts manual test cases into executable automated scripts by analyzing your repo,
grading each case by automation readiness (easy, medium, difficult), and bulk-converting the ones
you approve. And it runs those tests in Qase Cloud with parallel execution across multiple browsers,
no local infrastructure required. Results flow back into your test runs automatically.

[Start automating →][51]
Which integrations does Qase support?
Qase has 35+ integrations across CI/CD pipelines, test automation frameworks (Playwright, Selenium,
Cypress, Jest, and more), and issue trackers (Jira, GitHub, Linear). These are real, bidirectional
integrations — not surface-level connectors.

[Integrate →][52]
What is the Qase MCP server?
The Qase MCP server lets AI coding assistants — like Claude or GitHub Copilot — read test cases and
create test runs directly inside Qase. It's built for teams that want AI to participate in testing
workflows, not just code generation.

[Install the MCP →][53]
How is Qase priced?
Qase offers plans for teams of all sizes, from early-stage startups to enterprise engineering
organizations. Plans scale with team size, automation volume, and access to enterprise features like
SSO, advanced analytics, and dedicated support.

[See full pricing →][54]
How does Qase help teams make release decisions faster?
Instead of chasing approvals or copying results between systems, Qase gives every stakeholder a
shared, real-time view of release readiness, with requirement traceability that shows exactly what
was tested and what wasn't. Go/no-go becomes a data-driven call, not a meeting.

# PRECISION IN MEASUREMENT

LängeWinkelGeradheitSchwingungTemperatur

## Präzisionsmesstechnik

### für Industrie und Wissenschaft

Seit mehr als 30 Jahren zählt SIOS zu den führenden Unternehmen der präzisen Messtechnik. Wir bieten
Ihnen qualitativ hochwertige Standardsensoren sowie kundenspezifische OEM-Lösungen, z. B. für die
Bereiche Forschung & Entwicklung, Kalibrierwesen, Maschinenbau, Optik- und Halbleiterindustrie,
Medizintechnik, Nanomesstechnik und Geowissenschaft.

[Erfahren Sie mehr][33]

[[Laserinterferometer: Präzisionsmesstechnik von SIOS]][34]

## PRECISION IN MEASUREMENT

### Made in Germany

**SIOS entwickelt und fertigt laserinterferometrische Messtechnik und Präzisionsmessgeräte für die
Kalibrier- und Nanomesstechnik zur Messung von Länge, Winkel, Schwingung, Geradheit, Temperatur,
Kraft und weitere Messgrößen mit höchster Auflösung und geringer Messunsicherheit.**

**Messtechniker, Qualitätsprüfer, Ingenieure, Wissenschaftler und Einkäufer auf der ganzen Welt
vertrauen der Präzisionsmesstechnik von SIOS.**

[[Hochgenaue Präzisions-Messsysteme von SIOS im Überblick]][35]

### [ Produkte ][36]

Finden Sie das passende SIOS-Produkt für Ihre Messaufgabe: von der hochgenauen Längenmessung über
die kontinuierliche 6-DOF-Messung bis hin zur Messung von Nanostrukturen mit Hilfe von
Laserinterferometern, Laservibrometern, Messtastern, Nanomesstechnik, stabilisierten Lasern,
Klimamesstechnik.

[ SIOS Messsysteme ][37]
[[Anwendungen: In welchen Bereiche wird die Präzisionsmesstechnik von SIOS eingesetzt?]][38]

### [ Anwendungen ][39]

Erfahren Sie mehr über die vielfältigen Anwendungsmöglichkeiten unserer Geräte in der Praxis.
Messtechnik von SIOS wird immer dann eingesetzt, wenn es um präzise und verlässliche Messergebnisse
geht, z. B. für die Maschinenkalibrierung, Qualitätssicherung, Oberflächenmessung, Messungen im
Vakuum …

[ SIOS Anwendungen ][40]
[[OEM-Service: Maßgefertigte Präzisionsmesstechnik für individuelle Kundenwünsche]][41]

### [ OEM-Service ][42]

Individuelle Lösungen sind unsere Stärke. Dank unserer langjährigen Expertise, hohen Flexibilität
sowie dem modularen Aufbau unserer Messsysteme entwickeln wir maßgefertigte Lösung für spezielle
Kundenanforderungen. Davon profitieren insbesondere unsere Kunden im OEM-Bereich.

[ OEM-Lösungen ][43]

## Internationale Vertretungen

### Die Nähe zu unseren Kunden ist uns wichtig

Mit **23 Vertretungen für 30 Ländern** können wir Sie optimal und umfassend betreuen. Unsere
Vertriebspartner kommunizieren mit Ihnen sowohl technisch als auch sprachlich auf Augenhöhe. Sie
kennen die lokalen Marktanforderungen und kulturellen Besonderheiten.
Unsere Partner verfügen über umfangreiche Erfahrungen im Bereich Laser interferometrische
Messtechnik und finden die perfekte Lösung für Ihre individuellen Herausforderungen.  

[Ansprechpartner finden][44]

# PRECISION IN MEASUREMENT

## Präzisionsmesstechnik

### für Industrie und Wissenschaft

Seit mehr als 30 Jahren zählt SIOS zu den führenden Unternehmen der präzisen Messtechnik. Wir bieten
Ihnen qualitativ hochwertige Standardsensoren sowie kundenspezifische OEM-Lösungen, z. B. für die
Bereiche Forschung & Entwicklung, Kalibrierwesen, Maschinenbau, Optik- und Halbleiterindustrie,
Medizintechnik, Nanomesstechnik und Geowissenschaft.

[Erfahren Sie mehr][33]

[[Laserinterferometer: Präzisionsmesstechnik von SIOS]][34]

## PRECISION IN MEASUREMENT

### Made in Germany

**SIOS entwickelt und fertigt laserinterferometrische Messtechnik und Präzisionsmessgeräte für die
Kalibrier- und Nanomesstechnik zur Messung von Länge, Winkel, Schwingung, Geradheit, Temperatur,
Kraft und weitere Messgrößen mit höchster Auflösung und geringer Messunsicherheit.**

**Messtechniker, Qualitätsprüfer, Ingenieure, Wissenschaftler und Einkäufer auf der ganzen Welt
vertrauen der Präzisionsmesstechnik von SIOS.**

[[Hochgenaue Präzisions-Messsysteme von SIOS im Überblick]][35]

### [ Produkte ][36]

Finden Sie das passende SIOS-Produkt für Ihre Messaufgabe: von der hochgenauen Längenmessung über
die kontinuierliche 6-DOF-Messung bis hin zur Messung von Nanostrukturen mit Hilfe von
Laserinterferometern, Laservibrometern, Messtastern, Nanomesstechnik, stabilisierten Lasern,
Klimamesstechnik.

[ SIOS Messsysteme ][37]
[[Anwendungen: In welchen Bereiche wird die Präzisionsmesstechnik von SIOS eingesetzt?]][38]

### [ Anwendungen ][39]

Erfahren Sie mehr über die vielfältigen Anwendungsmöglichkeiten unserer Geräte in der Praxis.
Messtechnik von SIOS wird immer dann eingesetzt, wenn es um präzise und verlässliche Messergebnisse
geht, z. B. für die Maschinenkalibrierung, Qualitätssicherung, Oberflächenmessung, Messungen im
Vakuum …

[ SIOS Anwendungen ][40]
[[OEM-Service: Maßgefertigte Präzisionsmesstechnik für individuelle Kundenwünsche]][41]

### [ OEM-Service ][42]

Individuelle Lösungen sind unsere Stärke. Dank unserer langjährigen Expertise, hohen Flexibilität
sowie dem modularen Aufbau unserer Messsysteme entwickeln wir maßgefertigte Lösung für spezielle
Kundenanforderungen. Davon profitieren insbesondere unsere Kunden im OEM-Bereich.

[ OEM-Lösungen ][43]

## Internationale Vertretungen

### Die Nähe zu unseren Kunden ist uns wichtig

Mit **23 Vertretungen für 30 Ländern** können wir Sie optimal und umfassend betreuen. Unsere
Vertriebspartner kommunizieren mit Ihnen sowohl technisch als auch sprachlich auf Augenhöhe. Sie
kennen die lokalen Marktanforderungen und kulturellen Besonderheiten.
Unsere Partner verfügen über umfangreiche Erfahrungen im Bereich Laser interferometrische
Messtechnik und finden die perfekte Lösung für Ihre individuellen Herausforderungen.  

[Ansprechpartner finden][44]

## Model-Based Inspection & Measurement Software

One Common Metrology Platform for all 3D Measuring Devices

[Experience Verisurf 2026][71]
[Verisurf at IMTS 2026][72]

**See the difference Verisurf can make in your manufacturing.**

Manufacturers require more reporting, traceability, and continuity of data than ever before.
Intelligent 3D CAD models are now the standard design authority in manufacturing and continue the
digital thread throughout the manufacturing.

Verisurf metrology software lets you see the difference between the
nominal CAD design and finished machine part in real-time. Perfect for fast, in-process first
article or automated production inspection that improves your manufacturing enterprise.

**Model Based Definition for precise quality processes.**

**Work with any CAD format and measure with any device.**

**Fast measurement platform for profitable manufacturing.**

## **CMM Programming**

Object oriented CMM programming with efficient operation and quality reporting for all brands of
CMMs.

## **Inspection & Analysis
## **

Connect to any manual and portable CMMs for probing and scanning. Inspect to drawings or CAD models
with intelligent MBD.

## **Tool Building**

Use portable CMMs to build tools, jigs and fixtures. Perform alignments, drift checks, and bundling,
and inspect to CAD in real time.

## **Reverse Engineering**

3D scan and probe parts for additive manufacturing and other digitizing tasks. Complete surface and
solid modeling with MBD.
